title: Reduced MEK inhibition preserves genomic stability in naïve human ES cells
protocol: Mix DMEM/F-12 and Neurobasal medium in a 50:50 ratio.
Add 1x N2 supplement to the mixture.
Add 1x B27 supplement to the mixture.
Pipette 10 ng/mL of bFGF into the mixture.
Dissolve 1% nonessential amino acids in the solution.
Mix in 1mM GlutaMAX.
Add penicillin-streptomycin to the medium.
Include 0.1 mM beta-mercaptoethanol.
Pipette 50 μg/mL of BSA into the mixture.
Add 0.5 μM IM-12.
Mix in 0.5 μM SB590885.
Dissolve 1 μM WH-4-023 and add to the solution.
Include 10 μM Y-27632.
Pipette 20 ng/mL of Activin A into the mixture.
Add 20 ng/mL rhLIF to the medium.
Mix in 0.5% KSR.
Add 0.5 μM PD0325901 to the solution.
Supplement the medium with one of the following inhibitors at 0.5 μM: Refametinib, TAK-733, Cobimetinib.
Mix DMEM/F-12 and Neurobasal medium in a 50:50 ratio to create the _t2iLGöY_ medium.

Add 1x N2 supplement, 1x B27 supplement, 10 ng/mL bFGF, 1% nonessential amino acids, 1 mM GlutaMAX, penicillin-streptomycin, 0.1 mM beta-mercaptoethanol, 50 μg/mL BSA, 1 μM PD0325901, 1 μM CHIR99021, 2.5 μM Gö6983, 10 μM Y-27632, 20 ng/mL hLIF, and 50 μg/ml ascorbic acid to the _t2iLGöY_ medium.
Filter all culture media with a 0.22μm filter before use.
Maintain conventional primed human ESCs in a feeder-free TeSR-E8 medium.
Passage conventional primed human ESCs every 4-5 days at a 1:4 ratio.
Coat culture wells with Matrigel for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Wash primed hESCs with PBS.
Add Versene solution for ~5 minutes.
Aspirate the Versene solution.
Wash with PBS.
Add fresh TeSR-E8 and break colonies into small clumps by pipetting.
Optionally, add 10 μM Y-27632 to the TeSR-E8 media.
Culture cells in a 37°C, 5% O₂ and 5% CO₂ incubator.
Change media daily.
Plate irradiated CF-1 MEFs at 2.5x10^6 cells per 9.5 cm² on Matrigel-coated dishes the day before conversion.
Treat primed hESCs with TrypLE for 3-5 minutes to dissociate into single-cell suspension.
Plate cells at a density of 30,000 cells per 9.5 cm² on irradiated CF-1 MEFs in TeSR-E8 supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Replace medium the day after passaging with fresh TeSR-E8.
Change medium to 5i/LAF two days post-passaging and replace daily.
Passage naive-like hESCs onto a fresh layer of irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a 1:1-1:2 ratio after 8-10 days.
Treat naive hESCs with Accutase for five minutes at 37°C for passaging.
Dissociate naive hESCs into a single-cell suspension and resuspend in MEF medium.
Filter cells through a cell strainer (40 μm, Corning).
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed cells on fresh irradiated MEFs in 5i/LAF medium.
Plate irradiated CF-1 MEFs the day before in MEF medium on Matrigel-coated dishes.
Treat primed hESCs with TrypLE-expressed enzyme and dissociate into a single-cell suspension.
Plate primed hESCs at a density of 30,000 cells per 9.5 cm² on irradiated CF-1 MEFs in TeSR-E8 medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Replace the medium the day after passaging with fresh TeSR-E8.
Change the medium to m5i/LAF two days after passaging and replace it daily.
Plate irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a density of 2.5x10^6 cells per 9.5 cm² the day before conversion on Matrigel-coated dishes in MEF medium.
Treat hESCs with TrypLE expressed enzyme to dissociate into a single-cell suspension.
Plate hESCs at a density of 30,000 cells per 9.5 cm² on irradiated CF-1 MEFs in TeSR-E8 medium supplemented with 10 μM Y-27632.
Replace the medium the day after with fresh TeSR-E8.
Change the medium to 4i/LAF supplemented with 0.5 μM alternative MEK inhibitor two days after passaging.
Replace the medium daily.
Passage cells onto a fresh layer of irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a 1:1-1:2 ratio.
Expect dome-shaped colonies to arise after 3-5 passages.
Passage naive hESCs every 6-7 days.
Treat hESCs with Accutase for five minutes at 37°C for passaging.
Dissociate cells into a single-cell suspension and resuspend in MEF medium.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed the cells on fresh irradiated MEFs in 4i/LAF medium supplemented with 0.5 μM alternative MEK inhibitor.
Convert some primed hESC lines resistant to naïve conversion in m5i/LAF conditions using 5i/LAF medium initially.
Passage cells at P5 from 5i/LAF medium onto a fresh layer of irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a 1:3 ratio.
Switch cells to m5i/LAF medium and passage onto a fresh layer of irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a 1:2-1:3 ratio every 6-7 days.
Treat hESCs with Accutase for five minutes at 37°C.
Dissociate hESCs into a single-cell suspension.
Resuspend cells in MEF medium.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed the cells on fresh irradiated MEFs in m5i/LAF medium.
Switch cells to t2iLGöY medium and passage onto a fresh layer of irradiated CF-1 MEFs at a 1:3 ratio every 6-7 days.
Treat hESCs with Accutase for five minutes at 37°C.
Dissociate hESCs into a single-cell suspension.
Resuspend cells in MEF medium.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 minutes.
Seed the cells on fresh irradiated MEFs in t2iLGöY medium.
